t: Smooths out minor faults, broken surfaces, scratches and other imperfections up to 2mm deep prior to painting or wallpapering. Can be applied to plaster, plasterboard, gypsum blocks, concrete, cellular concrete, cement, brick, stone and previously painted surfaces. Coverage: 1.8m² per 600g tub (at 2mm thick).
b: For Filling of Cracks, Scratches & Surface Imperfections on Walls & Ceilings
Fine Particles Enable a Smooth Finish
